caption: The video captures a foggy, low-contrast sandy beach where several small groups of people stand scattered in the haze. On the left, a large iridescent soap-bubble film hovers just above the sand, its rounded dome trailing a rainbow-sheened tail. Throughout the clip this bubble structure steadily drifts leftward, the dome flattening and lowering while the tail contracts and shifts toward the frame edge. In the center a person in a light top and dark trousers stands with both arms raised, a thin line visible overhead, making only small pose adjustments as the film moves. Just behind them another figure in reddish clothing also raises their arms. On the right a person in a red shirt stands with arms bent, and a couple stands close together at the far edge. The whole scene stays muted, with the right-side figures remaining broadly steady relative to one another.
